notes: Clicked for credits almost every turn up to 43 credits and never installed a program; let the Corp score agendas from naked or one-ice remotes (Server 6, Server 9) without contesting them.
Iced remotes and scored GFI, Nisei and CST steadily; small oddities include clicking for credits while holding 12-26 credits and leaving a Launch Campaign unrezzed for eight turns.
Reinstalled Chameleon for 2 credits every turn but almost never ran, facechecked Cobra twice (once with Stimhack core damage) and jacked out after passing it, and lost the hand to Snare on turn 1.
Sound scoring remote behind Tollbooth and cheap Resistors; Sensie draws caused repeated discards and credits fell to 2-3 late, but the plan worked.

Early steals were good, but the Runner fed Corroder and Key Master to an already-rezzed Lancelot, then ran into it about eight times with no way to break it; Security Testing was retargeted pointlessly and credits stayed at 2-7.

Hoarded 13-32 credits and clicked for credits for about ten turns while discarding every turn; R&D kept a single Resistor even though the Runner hit it every turn and won through it; Hard-Hitting News and Psychographics had no follow-up.

Pressure on R&D and HQ with Amina and Paperclip was coherent, but the Runner ran on credits near zero for many turns, facechecked Hagen without a killer, and ignored the freshly installed Server 4 agenda that was scored next turn.

Clicked for credits for four turns while holding Plascrete, Clone Chips and Astrolabe, then against a known tag-and-meat Corp failed to boost link with 15 credits against SEA Source and was flatlined by double Scorched Earth.
After scoring NAPD the Corp clicked for credits for five straight turns up to 22 credits, discarding each turn, while the Runner ran R&D through a lone Pop-up Window and stole three agendas.
Lost AstroScript to a turn-1 Lady run through single ice, then built PAD economy and scored Breaking News and three NAPDs from Enigma-protected remotes cleanly.
Reached 5 points by turn 14 against a passive Runner but took 16 more turns to close, spending dozens of clicks advancing ice and cycling NGO Front and IPO while sitting on 30-44 credits.

Good HQ pressure with Lady stole Atlas, but the Runner never solved the Enigma on the scoring remote, pointed Cyber-Cypher at HQ instead of the remote, and spent turns on empty Archives runs and a Same Old Thing that did nothing.

Scored 5 points by turn 10, then stalled about 15 turns clicking for credits with up to 46 credits and discarding; played Punitive Counterstrike three times for 0 damage and never used the Runner's frequent tags.

Early R&D digging was reasonable, but from turn 8 the Runner only clicked for credits up to 39 with a full grip and no breaker installed, while the Corp scored four agendas behind a 1-credit Quandary.

Steady HQ/R&D pressure won the game, but the Runner sat on several tags for many turns (installing Ghost Runner while tagged so it was trashed) and spent a turn running into a known Tollbooth while broke.
Installed AstroScript and then two Project Beales one after another in a remote guarded only by a Resistor that the Runner's Paperclip had already broken, with 0-3 credits, and lost on turn 4.

Aggressive and effective, using Aesop's for economy and stealing repeatedly from a weak remote; the R&D facecheck lost Atman to Grim, and Argus meat damage was managed by drawing back up before each steal.
Against Noise mill the Corp never iced Archives and clicked for credits for about eight turns, discarding to hand size each turn, so four agendas ended up in Archives and were stolen.
Won only because the Runner was passive: from turn 7 to turn 18 the Corp clicked for credits and played economy cards up to 71 credits without installing or scoring anything.

Explosive start with 4 points on turn 1, then long passive stretches of clicking for credits with 13-25 credits, including drawing instead of contesting the Server 9 agenda that was scored next turn; won by checking Archives.
